incident-bot: PAGER: reranker-service elevated 5xx rate (p95 latency also spiking). affected routes: /v1/rerank, /v1/search/rerank. paging jamal (primary) and olivia (secondary). initial alert at 2026-11-12T21:07:14Z
jamal: I'm on it. seeing steady OOM-ish logs on reranker hosts, memory climbs >95% then process restarts.
jamal: quick mitigation: scaled reranker Dedicated pool +2 nodes, applied emergency circuit-breaker for large-request-size (>20k tokens) route, and reverted last canary that changed batching behavior.
olivia: copied. are we seeing customer errors? any major customers impacted?
jamal: A handful of high-throughput customers on dedicated capacity saw 5xx for ~3-7m during the spike. overall successful requests recovered after scale. No data loss.
carla-csm: FYI -- CSMs reported two customers (Acme & NovaFin) noticed intermittent failures; they're asking for incident summary and ETA.
jamal: noted. asked support to send preliminary note.
lina: can we get heapdumps from a crashed host? put path in S3?
jamal: yes, uploading now -> s3://redwood-internal/rrk/heapdumps/2239991234/ . grabbed one with pstack + jmap, saved core. logs: ```
[2026-11-12T21:05:09Z] reranker[pid=4129]: heap used 3.9G / limit 4G
[2026-11-12T21:05:29Z] reranker[pid=4129]: GC pause 320ms; mem still growing
[2026-11-12T21:06:02Z] reranker[pid=4129]: process killed by OOM
```
jamal: runbook used: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/reranker-memory-leak (step: isolate bad batching config). followed step 1-3.
deploy-bot: deploy rollback v2.14.1 -> v2.14.0 executed by jamal @ 2026-11-12T21:12:01Z :white_check_mark:
olivia: good. I'll take primary for the night to monitor tail for 4 hours. jamal, are there any coverage gaps?
jamal: handing off. primary -> olivia (2026-11-12T21:15Z). secondary -> kevin until 02:00 UTC. gap: infra-kernel team is offline until 06:00 UTC PST, so deep perf debugging requiring kernel tracing will wait. short-term mitigations are operational.
olivia: acknowledged. current status: errors down to baseline, p95 latency improving but still +12% vs normal. active mitigation: keep extra Dedicated nodes for next 2 hours, lower reranker batch size limit config to 8, enable prefix KV caching for common queries.
kevin: noted, I'll be watching teleport alerts and can escalate if we see regressions.
carla-csm: please add a short incident summary for customers: what happened, impact window, mitigations, ETA for root-cause. we need it by +30m.
jamal: drafting now, will post to #incidents-customer-notify and share to CSMs.
lina: post-mortem owner suggestion: jamal + lina as co-owners, due in 3 business days. we should include load repro steps and batching config diff.
olivia: assigning postmortem to jamal+lina. action items: (1) analyze heapdump (jamal) (2) reproduce locally with stress tool (lina) (3) adjust default batching thresholds (eng-runtime) (4) customer comms (carla-csm).
jamal: I've added the tasks to the incident board: https://internal.redwood.dev/board/INC-223999 .
olivia: quick note for next shift: ensure infra oncall aware of kernel tracing need; add a ticket to schedule with infra (owner: olivia).
jamal: passing primary to olivia now. I'll be reachable but stepping off pager for the night.
olivia: taking primary. monitoring logs + dashboards. will update if anything changes. :thumbsup: 
incident-bot: INCIDENT: update recorded (severity: Sev2 -> mitigating), uptime impact: 3-7 minutes for subset of customers, customers affected: Acme, NovaFin (escalated).
olivia: final housekeeping: runbook link again -> https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/reranker-memory-leak, heapdump path -> s3://redwood-internal/rrk/heapdumps/2239991234/, postmortem owners -> jamal, lina, customer comms -> carla-csm, next check-in in 30m.
carla-csm: I'll prepare the customer note template and ping you both for review.
kevin: I'm on standby until 02:00 UTC.
jamal: thanks all. handoff complete.
olivia: handoff acked. monitoring and will follow up with postmortem link when available.
